sessionStart.command: sh -c '[ "$PRISMOR_DOGFOOD" = 0 ] && exit 0; for py in "$PRISMOR_DEV_PYTHON" python3 python; do [ -n "$py" ] && "$py" -c "import yaml" </dev/null 2>/dev/null && exec "$py" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/dev-hook.py" hook-dispatch --agent cursor --mode observe; done; echo "prismor dogfood: no python with pyyaml found (pip install pyyaml, or set PRISMOR_DEV_PYTHON)" >&2; exit 2'
